title: 第一卷 南域篇 第13章 红衣怒马河阳尘第一卷 南域篇 第14章 只身赴独山
slug: 剑问九州第1286章星域虫潮
content_zh:
清晨的河阳城，到处都彰显着蓬勃的朝气。南北贯通，东西笔直的城道上，铺满了从独山开采出来的青石板。
城主府大门的两头石狮，据说是城内最有名的石匠，亲自进山挑选了千斤重的玄玉，花费一年时间才雕刻出来，用以庆祝现任城主慕随风走马上任。
大街小巷，放眼望去，满是走夫贩卒，江湖术士，四方游侠和世家公子。
商会在城东，雇佣兵的聚集地在城西，城北是城主府的地盘，而城南则驻扎着河阳城守备军。
护城河在朝阳的映照下波光粼粼，城池古拙大气的勾栏建筑和贫民窟的低矮瓦房相互交织，构成了这座城市的谋篇布局。
“贩剑咯，贩剑！”骨骼清奇的道长背着剑匣沿街叫卖，“上好的青冈剑！上能斩妖除魔，下能烹羊宰牛且为乐，瞧一瞧看一看咯！走过路过，千万不要错过！”
“算卦算卦！上知天文，下知地理，河阳第一神算子，求得了姻缘，算得了福祸！”街头术士扛着布旗高声吆喝，“一卦十两钱！十两钱，教你青楼梦好，却教不了你柳下约娇娘！十两钱，吃得了醉虾鲍鱼，却吃不得一生平畅！算卦算卦，走过错过，没有来过，人生何其寂寞！”
白泽一路走来，倒是听乐了。且不说这群神棍手艺如何，单是这张巧嘴，他若非囊中羞涩，必然打赏一番。
越到城东，河阳城街就越是热闹。三五成群的剑侠，独行潇洒的刀客，应接不暇，好一番九州江湖！
接近商会，身后的人群忽然躁动起来。白泽一听，由远及近的马蹄声震地而来，至少有十余骑，还都是绝尘好马。
“闪开！闪开！”开道的先锋一身城主府制式盔甲，银光闪闪，横刀立马，一骑绝尘。
街道行人纷纷避让。
“谁啊，这么嚣张？”有年轻的游侠不满地叫了一声，“居然城中跑马？”
“嘘！不要命啦。”身边一老者赶紧拉了他一把，说：“河阳城中跑马的，能有多少？非尊即贵！”
白泽负剑站在城道一侧，视线一转，顿见不远一匹红缨白马呼啸而来，马蹄击地，声如鼓点。马上一红衣少女长发飘飘，面容精致，一身贴身软甲，将含苞待放的身段勾勒得令人心醉。
长剑翠烟横于马上，少女娇媚中带着飒爽英姿，逆光而来，直若出尘仙子。
“果然是她！”白泽淡然一笑，如此嚣张，又有城主府亲卫相护，不是河阳城主慕随风之女河阳郡主慕轻灵，又是谁？
红衣少女绝尘而去，十余骑随从亲卫纵马跟上，端是个好大气派！
人群在慕轻灵通过之后，再次熙攘起来。白泽跟着人流前行，想起第一次前来河阳城时的场景。
那日醉仙楼上，谢玄正兀自饮酒，城主府忽然派人送来拜帖，城主慕随风拜请谢玄入府赐剑三招。

当时整个醉仙楼轰动一时，谢玄喝了口酒，并不接帖。直言：“若想请剑，叫你们城主亲自来拜。”
“这老者什么来头，城主拜剑，行的已经是我燕国大礼，居然还要城主亲自跑一趟！？”当时在场的贵宾集体被谢玄一句“亲自来拜”震懵。
然而更猛的还在后面，不出一刻，慕随风居然真的亲自前来拜剑了！
“嘶！”整座醉仙楼都是抽气声。
白泽就这么跟谢玄进了城主府，然后两人相约子时共赴独山，三剑为请，不分生死，点到为止。
“喂，你跟那个老头什么关系啊？”白泽被谢玄丢在城主府，深夜时分，两人御气前往独山，偌大庭院内除了守备，只剩下他和慕轻灵。
“我可不叫喂，我有名字。”白泽哼了一声，懒得搭理慕轻灵，“那是我师傅。”
“你这小孩，脾气还挺大！”慕轻灵嘻嘻一笑，拉着白泽坐在荷塘轩谢之中，拿出她珍藏的芙蓉楼小食，贿赂白泽，说：“那你说，你叫什么？我叫慕轻灵，方才跟你师傅去独山请剑的，是我父亲，也是这座河阳城的镇守城主，慕随风！”
言语间颇有得意。
白泽是个嘴馋的主，看到吃的就走不动道，就着古风庭院里，轩谢之外的荷塘月色，不客气地吃了起来，边吃边说：“我，白泽！白玉无瑕的白，泽被天下的泽！”
“人没多大，口气倒是不小。那你师傅呢？”慕轻灵趴在雕纹白玉桌上，戳了戳白泽的包子脸，觉得可爱，噗嗤一笑，说：“你还别说，你吃东西的样子好像仓鼠，真可爱！”
content_en:
In the early morning, Heyang City is full of vitality. The straight city road running from north to south and east to west is covered with bluestone slabs mined from Dushan.
The two stone lions at the gate of the city lord's palace are said to be the most famous stonemason in the city. He personally went to the mountain to select a thousand kilograms of mysterious jade, and it took him a year to carve them out to celebrate the current city lord Mu Suifeng's taking office.
As you look around the streets and alleys, you can see they are full of peddlers, sorcerers, knights from all directions and young men from aristocratic families.
The Chamber of Commerce is in the east of the city, the mercenary gathering place is in the west of the city, the north of the city is the territory of the city lord's palace, and the south of the city is stationed with the Heyang City garrison.
The moat sparkles in the morning sun, and the ancient and grand hook-railed buildings of the city and the low tiled houses of the slums are intertwined, forming the layout of the city.
"Selling swords, selling swords!" The Taoist Priest with strange bones carried a sword box and hawked along the street. "The best Qinggang sword! It can kill demons and eliminate demons at the top, and cook sheep and cattle for fun at the bottom. Take a look! Don't miss it if you pass by!"
"Foresight and fortune-telling! He knows astronomy from above and geography from below. He is the best fortune teller in Heyang. He can find marriages and calculate fortune and misfortune!" The street magician carried a cloth flag and shouted loudly, "Ten taels per hexagram! Twelve taels can teach you how to dream of a brothel, but it can't teach you how to date a girl under the willow! For 12 taels, you can eat drunken shrimps and abalone, but you can't have a smooth life! Fortune-telling, passing by and missing, never coming, life is so lonely!"
Bai Ze enjoyed it along the way. Not to mention the skills of these magic sticks, if he were not short of money, he would definitely reward them for their clever mouth.
The further you go to the east of the city, the more lively the streets of Heyang City become. Swordsmen in groups and swordsmen walking alone are overwhelmed, and it's a great experience in the world of Jiuzhou!
As they approached the Chamber of Commerce, the crowd behind them suddenly became restless. When Bai Ze heard this, the sound of horse hooves from far and near shook the ground. There were at least ten horses riding on them, and they were all excellent horses.
"Get out of the way! Get out of the way!" The vanguard who opened the way was wearing the city lord's palace standard armor, shining with silver, and he stood on horseback with a horizontal sword and a powerful horse.
Pedestrians on the street gave way.
"Who is so arrogant?" A young ranger shouted dissatisfied, "A horse racing in the city?"
"Hush! You don't want to die." An old man beside him quickly pulled him and said, "How many horse racers are there in Heyang City? Either you are noble or you are noble!"
Bai Ze stood on the side of the city road with his sword behind his back. He turned his eyes and suddenly saw a white horse with red tassels roaring towards him not far away. The horse's hooves hit the ground, making a sound like a drum beat. Immediately, a girl in red clothes had long flowing hair, a delicate face, and a body-hugging soft armor, which outlined her budding figure in a mesmerizing way.
The green smoke of the long sword lies across the horse, and the girl is charming with a valiant and heroic posture, coming against the light, just like a fairy from the world.
"Sure enough, it's her!" Bai Ze smiled indifferently. She was so arrogant and protected by the guards of the City Lord's Mansion. If not Mu Qingling, the daughter of Heyang City Lord Mu Suifeng, who could Heyang Princess Mu Qingling be?
The girl in red walked away, followed by more than ten cavalry and personal guards, she was so grand!
After Mu Qingling passed by, the crowd became bustling again. Bai Ze followed the crowd and remembered the scene when he first came to Heyang City.
That day in Zuixian Tower, Xie Xuan was drinking alone, when the city lord's palace suddenly sent someone to deliver a greeting card. City lord Mu Suifeng asked Xie Xuan to enter the palace and grant him three sword moves.
At that time, the whole Zuixian Tower was in a sensation. Xie Xuan took a sip of wine and did not answer the post. He said bluntly: "If you want to ask for a sword, ask your city lord to come and worship in person."
"What's the background of this old man? The city lord is paying homage to the sword, which is already a great gift from our country of Yan, but he actually wants the city lord to go there in person!?" The VIPs present at the time were all shocked by Xie Xuan's words "come to worship in person".
However, what was even worse was yet to come. Within a moment, Mu Suifeng actually came to worship the sword in person!
"Hiss!" The whole Zuixian Tower gasped.
Bai Ze and Xie Xuan entered the city lord's palace like this, and then the two of them made an appointment to go to Dushan together. They invited three swords, regardless of life or death, until the point was reached.
"Hey, youWhat does it have to do with that old man? "Bai Ze was left in the city lord's palace by Xie Xuan. Late at night, the two of them headed to Dushan with Yu Qi. Apart from the guards, only he and Mu Qingling were left in the huge courtyard.
"I'm not calling him hello, I have a name. Bai Ze snorted and was too lazy to talk to Mu Qingling, "That's my master." "
"You kid, you have quite a temper! Mu Qingling smiled, pulled Bai Ze to sit in the lotus pond, took out her treasured Furonglou snacks, bribed Bai Ze, and said, "Then tell me, what is your name?" My name is Mu Qingling, and the person who just went to Dushan with your master to ask for a sword was my father, Mu Suifeng, who is also the guardian of Heyang City! "
The words were quite proud.
Bai Ze was a greedy person, and he couldn't walk when he saw food. He ate it without any ceremony, looking at the moonlight of the lotus pond outside the Xuan Xie in the ancient courtyard, and while eating, he said: "I, Bai Ze!" The flawless whiteness of white jade is the beauty of the world! "
“The man is not very big, but his tone is not small. What about your master? "Mu Qingling lay on the carved white jade table and poked Bai Ze's bun face. She thought it was cute. She chuckled and said, "Don't tell me, you look like a hamster when you eat. It's so cute!" "
